public.title: Rotate Array
public.description: Rotate values right by k positions and return the result. There are 0 to 1000 integer values from -10000 to 10000; k is an integer from 0 to 1000000. Empty input returns []. Mutation is optional.
hints: Reduce k modulo the array length.
public.attribution: Original Bekor statement, examples, tests and solutions, 2026. Adapted from a standard algorithmic problem; no third-party exercise text used.

explanation: Split at length minus the effective shift and concatenate the suffix before the prefix. O(n) time and output space.
